title: accounts payable manager
description:
Prefr (operated by CreditVidya) is a digital-first lending platform that makes credit accessible to millions across India. with loan offerings ranging from ₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh, we’re enabling instant personal loans and flexible pay-later credit lines, especially for first-time borrowers and underserved regions. backed by RBI-approved NBFC partnerships, we’ve built a platform that uses selfie-based KYC, minimal documentation, and AI-powered underwriting to disburse loans within minutes.
we are seeking an experienced Finance Manager to oversee the accounting, payments, and treasury functions for a fast-growing Fintech company and will lead the AP team, ensuring timely and accurate payments of company liabilities, optimizing the AP process, and working closely with vendors, procurement, and internal stakeholders. the Finance Manager will ensure compliance with statutory requirements (TDS, GST, MSME Act, Companies Act) and optimize cash flow management while driving financial process improvements and ensuring the accuracy of financial statements.
What will you do?
-
oversee daily accounting operations, including managing the general ledger, journal entries, reconciliations, and month-end closing
-
ensure timely and accurate processing of payments (vendor payments, taxes) and adherence to internal control standards
-
establish and maintain strong relationships with vendors, ensuring effective dispute resolution and favorable terms
-
manage treasury functions, including cash flow management, forecasting, and working capital optimization
-
ensure compliance with statutory regulations, including TDS, GST, MSME Act, and Companies Act, and coordinate with auditors during internal and external audits
-
develop and implement financial policies, procedures, and internal controls to safeguard company assets
-
prepare and publish AP-related reports (e.g., cash flow forecasting, aging analysis)
-
collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., product team, sales team, collection team, Admin team) to ensure financial alignment with business operations
-
prepare, analyze, and present financial reports to senior management, including cash flow projections and variance analysis
-
lead initiatives to improve financial systems and processes, leveraging automation tools. Optimize the AP workflow through automation, process improvements, and implementation of best practices
-
monitor and manage banking relationships
-
manage vendor onboarding and master vendor data maintenance, ensuring data accuracy
-
manage and mentor a team of AP specialists, providing training and performance feedback
You should apply if you are/have:
-
Chartered Accountant with 4-7 years of experience
-
deep understanding of Indian statutory regulations (TDS, GST, MSME Act, Companies Act)
-
proven track record of process improvement and automation in AP
-
strong knowledge of treasury management, cash flow forecasting, and working capital optimization
-
experience in financial reporting, reconciliations, and managing audits
-
good communication and interpersonal skills to articulate and collaborate across departments

description:
prefr (operated by CreditVidya) is a digital-first lending platform that makes credit accessible to millions across India. with loan offerings ranging from ₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh, we’re enabling instant personal loans and flexible pay-later credit lines, especially for first-time borrowers and underserved regions. backed by RBI-approved NBFC partnerships, we’ve built a platform that uses selfie-based KYC, minimal documentation, and AI-powered underwriting to disburse loans within minutes.

what will you do:

you should apply if you have/are:

- strong understanding of the collections business.

title: business development & partnerships
description:
what is CRED?
 
CRED is an exclusive community for india’s most trustworthy and creditworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior. 
 
CRED was born out of a need to bring back the focus on a long lost virtue, one of trust, the idea being to create a community centered around this virtue. a community that constantly strives to become more virtuous in this regard till they finally scale their behavior to create a utopia where being trustworthy is the norm and not the exception. to build a community like this requires a community of its own; a community special in its own way, working towards making this vision come true. 
 
here’s a thought experiment: what do you get when you put a group of incredibly passionate and driven people and entrust them with the complete freedom to chase down their goals in a completely uninhibited manner? answer: you get something close to what we have at CRED; CRED just has it better. 
 
You’ll play a pivotal role in leading CRED's partner ecosystem across products, becoming the face of CRED to some of India’s top consumer brands. You will lead high-stakes partnerships, drive product adoption, and enable new growth through strategic merchant alliances. As a core part of the merchant-led growth (mlg) strategy, you’ll shape how millions engage with CRED.

what you’ll own
- driving acceptance of CRED payment instruments (upi, credit/affordability) with a sole focus of offering convenience for CRED members
- hunt, build and manage high-impact brand partnerships across categories relevant to CRED members
- drive meaningful member value through differentiated rewards, offers, privileges, and experiences
- work closely with internal cross-functional teams including product, growth, marketing, operations, and design to execute partnership initiatives successfully
- support the integration of rewards and merchant constructs across key product journeys and platform surfaces
- drive day-to-day partner management including execution, campaign launches, reporting, issue resolution, and performance tracking
- identify growth opportunities within existing partnerships and help scale high-performing constructs
- leverage consumer insights, transaction intelligence, and market understanding to identify relevant partnership opportunities
- ensure strong execution quality, partner experience, and member relevance across all initiatives
what we’re looking for
- 4+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, merchant growth, enterprise sales, category or account management within consumer internet, fintech, commerce, loyalty, or digital businesses
- experience managing and growing brand or merchant partnerships with measurable business outcomes
- understanding of consumer and merchant ecosystems across categories such as fashion, travel, food delivery, lifestyle, entertainment, retail, or digital services
- experience working cross-functionally with teams across product, marketing, operations, growth, analytics, or business functions
- strong ownership mindset with the ability to execute independently in fast-paced and evolving environments
- good business and commercial understanding with the ability to structure mutually valuable partnerships
- strong communication, relationship management, and stakeholder management skills
- comfort working with performance metrics, business data, and consumer insights to drive decisions and optimize outcomes

title: business development & strategic partnerships - d2c
description:
help shape CRED’s d2c ecosystem by partnering with India’s most exciting consumer brands and turning those relationships into meaningful member value and business growth.
you’ll work at the intersection of d2c, consumer growth, payments, rewards and product - bringing relevant brands and differentiated constructs to CRED members, while helping d2c businesses acquire customers, drive growth and build deeper engagement.
this is a role for someone who can spot opportunities, build relationships, sell, and turn ideas into high-impact partnerships.

what you’ll own
-
build and own the d2c pipeline - identify the right brands, founders and opportunities, and drive partnerships from first conversation to revenue realisation.
-
carry a revenue quota and relentlessly deliver against it through new business, monetisation and partner growth.
-
build deep relationships with d2c founders, cxos, growth leaders and the vc ecosystem backing the category.
-
create differentiated partnerships that drive brand growth, customer acquisition, retention and engagement.
-
bring the best d2c brands and propositions to CRED members through rewards, offers, experiences and privileges.
-
drive adoption of CRED payment instruments across high-quality d2c brands.
-
look beyond standard partnerships - identify strategic, product, payment, data and growth-led opportunities that can create outsized value for both CRED and the brand.
-
work cross-functionally with product, growth, marketing, analytics and operations to turn ideas into live, scaled partnerships.
-
own execution end-to-end - zero hand-holding, high velocity, and a strong bias for getting things done.
What we’re looking for 
This is not a relationship-management role. It is a builder + seller role for someone who wants to shape CRED’s d2c ecosystem.
-
4+ years in quota-carrying sales, business development, partnerships or key account roles within d2c, consumer internet, ecommerce, fintech or high-growth startups.
-
strong existing network across d2c founders, cxos, growth/marketing leaders and consumer brands.
-
deep understanding of the Indian d2c ecosystem and curiosity about emerging brands, categories and trends.
-
proven track record of closing deals and delivering commercial outcomes.
-
strong commercial and strategic thinking - able to look at a brand and quickly identify “what could we build together?”
-
high-energy, extremely driven and razor-sharp on execution.
-
excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to sell to founders and senior leadership.
-
comfortable operating in ambiguity, building from scratch and owning outcomes end-to-end.

working at CRED would instantly make you realize one thing: you are working with the best talent around you, not just in the role you occupy but everywhere you go. talk to someone around you; most likely you will be talking to a singer, stand-up comic, artist, writer, an athlete, or maybe a magician. at CRED, people always have talent up their sleeves. with the right company, even conversations can be rejuvenating. at CRED, we guarantee a good company.

there are many more such eccentricities that make CRED what it is, but that’s for one to discover. If you feel at home reading this, get in touch.

since trust is a major virtue in the community we have built, we make it a point to highlight it in the community behind CRED: all our employees get their salaries before their joining date. a show of trust that speaks volumes because of the skin in the game. 
 
there are many more such eccentricities that make CRED what it is but that’s for one to discover. if you feel at home reading this, get in touch.
